name: 12-Week Running Plan — Summer/Fall 2026
description: Existing 12-week running plan. Calendar week begins Monday, July 27, 2026, with the first run on Tuesday, July 28. Includes the 10-mile race on August 30 and a final 5K assessment.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes of controlled strength. Keep it moderate enough that Tuesday's workout is unaffected.

sessions.title: Threshold intervals
sessions.instructions: Warm up 10–15 minutes, then 4 × 5 minutes comfortably hard with 90 seconds easy jogging. Cool down 10 minutes.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Run conversationally with a natural stride. Do not force a heart-rate ceiling or race the final mile.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 4 miles relaxed. Judge the effort by breathing and repeatability, not a rigid heart-rate number.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 4 miles easy, then 4 × 20 seconds relaxed strides with full easy recovery.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 7 miles relaxed. Short walk breaks are fine if heat or cardiac drift becomes excessive.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes controlled strength.

sessions.title: Aerobic intervals
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 5 × 1,000 m at roughly 10K effort with 2 minutes easy jogging. Keep every repetition controlled.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy and conversational.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 4–5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 4–5 miles easy, then 5 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 8 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes controlled strength.

sessions.title: Threshold development
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 3 × 8 minutes at threshold effort with 2 minutes easy jogging. Cool down.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy first 2 miles; optional moderate final mile only if recovered from Tuesday.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 5 miles easy, then 5–6 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.instructions: 9 miles easy. Do not fast-finish this one.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: Light strength only; reduce lower-body volume slightly.

sessions.title: Cruise intervals
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 3 × 1 mile at threshold effort with 2–3 minutes easy jogging. Keep this controlled rather than racing the reps.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy and conversational.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 4–5 miles easy, then 4 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.instructions: 10 miles easy. This is the final long run before race week.

sessions.title: Race tune-up
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 4 × 400 m at approximately 10K effort with 400 m very easy jogging. Finish feeling fresh.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Run very easy. No progression finish.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 3–4 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Shakeout
sessions.instructions: 2–3 very easy miles with 3 × 15-second relaxed strides, or rest if you feel better without a shakeout.

sessions.title: 10-mile race
sessions.instructions: Race day: warm up briefly, start conservatively, and avoid turning the first 2 miles into a 10K effort.

sessions.title: Recovery
sessions.instructions: Rest or 20–30 minutes very easy if your legs feel surprisingly good.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy only. Skip it if soreness changes your stride.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 3–4 miles easy.

sessions.title: Easy
sessions.instructions: 4 miles relaxed; no strides unless fully recovered.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 6–7 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: Resume controlled strength.

sessions.title: 5K rhythm
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 8 × 400 m at current 5K effort with 200 m easy jogging.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy and conversational.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 5 miles easy, then 5 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 8 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes controlled strength.

sessions.title: Threshold intervals
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 4 × 6 minutes at threshold effort with 90 seconds easy jogging.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy; optional moderate final mile if Tuesday felt controlled.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 5 miles easy, then 6 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 9 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: Light-to-moderate strength.

sessions.title: Hill strength
sessions.instructions: 8 × 60 seconds uphill with easy jogging back down. Powerful but controlled.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy and conversational.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 4–5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy
sessions.instructions: 4–5 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 7–8 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes controlled strength.

sessions.title: 5K intervals
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 6 × 800 m at current 5K effort with 2½ minutes easy jogging.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy and conversational.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5–6 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 5 miles easy, then 6 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 9–10 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: 25–35 minutes controlled strength.

sessions.title: Threshold miles
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 3 × 1 mile at threshold effort with 2 minutes easy jogging.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Easy first 2 miles; optional moderate final mile.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic
sessions.instructions: 5–6 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Easy + strides
sessions.instructions: 5–6 miles easy, then 4–6 × 20 seconds relaxed strides.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 10 miles relaxed.

sessions.title: Rest / optional strength
sessions.instructions: Light strength.

sessions.title: Sharpening
sessions.instructions: Warm up, then 6 × 400 m slightly faster than 5K pace with 400 m very easy jogging.

sessions.title: Run club 5K
sessions.instructions: Use this as a controlled 5K assessment or keep it easy and test on Saturday.

sessions.title: Recovery
sessions.instructions: 3–4 miles very easy or rest.

sessions.title: Easy or 5K test
sessions.instructions: If you did not assess Wednesday, run a proper 5K test today after a full warm-up. Otherwise run 4–5 miles easy.

sessions.title: Long easy
sessions.instructions: 8 miles relaxed.
